title: Find relevant jobs faster with an AI job finder | SearchBreaker
description: Bring promising openings into one reviewable feed based on your goals and experience. Learn the workflow, its controls and what you can review before applying.

blocks.headline: Find relevant jobs faster with an AI job finder
blocks.lead: Set the roles, location and work mode you want. SearchBreaker gathers promising openings into one feed and shows why each one appears, when it was posted and where it came from.

blocks.heading: Where jobs come from
blocks.emptyTitle: No job sources are verified yet
blocks.emptyText: We test each source before listing it, including how often it refreshes. Until then, the coverage list stays empty rather than promise sources we have not checked.
blocks.footnote: Sources not listed here are not supported. Coverage and refresh limits are shown with the date of the last check.

faqs.a: Each opening shows when it was posted and where it came from, so you can judge freshness yourself. Refresh limits for each source appear in the coverage list once a source is verified.
Only verified sources are listed, with the date each was last tested. If a source is missing from the list, it is not covered.
No paid placement is planned. Order is based on your target roles and confirmed experience.
The same role posted on several sources is meant to appear once, with each source noted. Duplicate handling is part of what private testing checks.

faqs.q: Is the job finder available now?
